cards.back:
A society with its own culture, laws and way of life.
Bahasa Indonesia: peradaban
Example: The ancient Egyptian civilisation built pyramids beside the River Nile.
cards.say: civilisation. A society with its own culture, laws and way of life. The ancient Egyptian civilisation built pyramids beside the River Nile.

cards.back:
A group of lands ruled by one government or ruler.
Bahasa Indonesia: kekaisaran, imperium
Example: The Majapahit empire once ruled many islands in the region.
cards.say: empire. A group of lands ruled by one government or ruler. The Majapahit empire once ruled many islands in the region.

cards.back:
A land ruled by a king or queen.
Bahasa Indonesia: kerajaan
Example: The old kingdom was famous for its gold and spices.
cards.say: kingdom. A land ruled by a king or queen. The old kingdom was famous for its gold and spices.

cards.back:
A land ruled by another country.
Bahasa Indonesia: koloni, jajahan
Example: Many countries in Asia were once colonies of European powers.
cards.say: colony. A land ruled by another country. Many countries in Asia were once colonies of European powers.

cards.back:
Freedom from the control of another country.
Bahasa Indonesia: kemerdekaan
Example: Indonesia declared independence on the seventeenth of August, nineteen forty-five.
cards.say: independence. Freedom from the control of another country. Indonesia declared independence on the seventeenth of August, nineteen forty-five.

cards.back:
A sudden and big change, often in government or ideas.
Bahasa Indonesia: revolusi
Example: The Industrial Revolution brought machines into factories and homes.
cards.say: revolution. A sudden and big change, often in government or ideas. The Industrial Revolution brought machines into factories and homes.

cards.back:
A system of government led by a king or queen.
Bahasa Indonesia: monarki
Example: In a monarchy, power usually passes from a parent to a child.
cards.say: monarchy. A system of government led by a king or queen. In a monarchy, power usually passes from a parent to a child.

cards.back:
A system where people choose their leaders by voting.
Bahasa Indonesia: demokrasi
Example: In a democracy, citizens vote for their president.
cards.say: democracy. A system where people choose their leaders by voting. In a democracy, citizens vote for their president.

cards.back:
A line of rulers from the same family.
Bahasa Indonesia: dinasti
Example: The Tang dynasty ruled China for almost three hundred years.
cards.say: dynasty. A line of rulers from the same family. The Tang dynasty ruled China for almost three hundred years.

cards.back:
A person who studies the past by digging up old objects.
Bahasa Indonesia: arkeolog
Example: The archaeologist found a clay pot buried near the old temple.
cards.say: archaeologist. A person who studies the past by digging up old objects. The archaeologist found a clay pot buried near the old temple.

cards.back:
An object made by people long ago.
Bahasa Indonesia: artefak
Example: The museum displays an artefact from the Bronze Age.
cards.say: artefact. An object made by people long ago. The museum displays an artefact from the Bronze Age.

cards.back:
To dig carefully to find things buried in the ground.
Bahasa Indonesia: menggali
Example: Scientists excavate the site slowly with tiny brushes.
cards.say: excavate. To dig carefully to find things buried in the ground. Scientists excavate the site slowly with tiny brushes.

cards.back:
Words carved on stone or metal.
Bahasa Indonesia: prasasti
Example: The inscription on the stone told of a king's victory.
cards.say: inscription. Words carved on stone or metal. The inscription on the stone told of a king's victory.

cards.back:
A document or book written by hand, usually very old.
Bahasa Indonesia: naskah
Example: The manuscript was written on palm leaves long ago.
cards.say: manuscript. A document or book written by hand, usually very old. The manuscript was written on palm leaves long ago.

cards.back:
The order in which events happened.
Bahasa Indonesia: kronologi
Example: A timeline shows the chronology of the king's life.
cards.say: chronology. The order in which events happened. A timeline shows the chronology of the king's life.

cards.back:
A period of one hundred years.
Bahasa Indonesia: abad
Example: The temple was built in the ninth century.
cards.say: century. A period of one hundred years. The temple was built in the ninth century.

cards.back:
A long period of time known for something special.
Bahasa Indonesia: era, zaman
Example: The Stone Age was an era when tools were made from rock.
cards.say: era. A long period of time known for something special. The Stone Age was an era when tools were made from rock.

cards.back:
To take control of a place by force.
Bahasa Indonesia: menaklukkan
Example: The army set out to conquer the northern lands.
cards.say: conquer. To take control of a place by force. The army set out to conquer the northern lands.

cards.back:
To enter a country with an army to take control.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyerbu
Example: The enemy tried to invade the island at night.
cards.say: invade. To enter a country with an army to take control. The enemy tried to invade the island at night.

cards.back:
A written agreement between countries.
Bahasa Indonesia: perjanjian
Example: The two nations signed a treaty to end the war.
cards.say: treaty. A written agreement between countries. The two nations signed a treaty to end the war.

cards.back:
A person who is the first to do or explore something.
Bahasa Indonesia: perintis
Example: She was a pioneer who opened the first school for girls.
cards.say: pioneer. A person who is the first to do or explore something. She was a pioneer who opened the first school for girls.

cards.back:
Something left behind from the past for later people.
Bahasa Indonesia: warisan
Example: The scientist left a legacy of important discoveries.
cards.say: legacy. Something left behind from the past for later people. The scientist left a legacy of important discoveries.

cards.back:
A person in your family who lived long ago.
Bahasa Indonesia: leluhur, nenek moyang
Example: Our ancestor sailed here on a wooden boat.
cards.say: ancestor. A person in your family who lived long ago. Our ancestor sailed here on a wooden boat.
